style.backgroundSystem: flat oatmeal-cream #F6EBDC screens carrying one rounded white #FFFFFF content card at 24px corners, alternating with a single pale sea-mist green #BCD6C9 block screen behind the opening claim and one deep-roast brown #4A3A25 block screen reserved only for the closing screen; the feeding scene and the real-shot gallery are the only photographic home screens; one background treatment per screen, never a fourth background language
style.iconSystem: single-weight 2px thin-line pictograms in #4A3A25 seated inside plain circles with no fill, quarter-disc tabs in #E06A45 with #FFFFFF numerals, rounded pill labels joined to the kibble or the pack by one hairline leader line in #4A3A25; no medical crosses, no organ or kidney diagrams, no microbe illustrations, no seals, shields or medals
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused warm key from the upper left at 5200K with an even 5500K bounce fill, low contrast, gentle falloff, matte controlled highlights so the extruded kibble surface reads dry rather than greasy, and a real contact shadow under every pack, dish and single piece so nothing floats; the home scenes use natural window light from the left at 5200K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm honest pet-nutrition ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of oatmeal-cream panel #F6EBDC, card white #FFFFFF, pale sea-mist green block #BCD6C9, deep-roast brown ink and close block #4A3A25, one salmon-coral accent #E06A45, warm limestone surface #E3D9CC and one baked-kibble brown #B07C3E pinned for the product contents; warm tone throughout; one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin with one headline weight per screen, Chinese display headline 30-44pt in #4A3A25 on light fields and #FFFFFF on green and brown fields, a letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #A79683 at most once per screen, section divider of one hairline rule with a short centred solid dash, all copy as 「」 placeholders; background system of flat oatmeal-cream screens holding one 24px rounded white card, one pale sea-mist green block reserved for the opening, one deep-roast brown block reserved for the close, plus real home screens only for the feeding scene and the gallery; soft diffused warm key from the upper left at 5200K with an even 5500K bounce fill, low contrast, matte controlled highlights so the kibble reads dry, always a real contact shadow; infographic components limited to single-weight 2px thin-line pictograms inside plain circles, quarter-disc number tabs in #E06A45 with #FFFFFF numerals, and rounded pill labels on one hairline leader line, no medical or clinical iconography; the pack held upright at one consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, the extruded piece shape, size and matte baked tone held identical to the reference, never tiled, never glossy; any cat cropped or turned away so no individual identity reads; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no glossy 3D icons, no QR codes or store badges.
noDrift: no glossy 3D icons, sparkle, steam or cartoon drift
no QR codes, membership stickers or store promotion overlays
no invented ingredient lists, feeding amounts, ages, net weights, shelf-life values, breed claims, veterinary wording or certifications
no greasy wet sheen or plastic render on the kibble
style.presentationRules: the pack stays upright at one consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale across every screen, grounded by a contact shadow, its panel layout, seam and print placement true to the reference and never restyled, recoloured or cropped at the label face; the extruded piece shape, size and matte baked tone #B07C3E stay identical to the reference on all macro and flat-lay screens; card corners fixed at 24px; any cat appears cropped or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm limestone counter #E3D9CC, shallow glossy white ceramic dish #FFFFFF, one low oat-toned round pedestal, pale linen mat inside the home screens; kibble always read as separate pieces with crisp edges and a matte crumb surface, never a tiled repeating pattern, never wet-look, never plastic-smoothed
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for both Chinese and Latin; Chinese display headline 30-44pt in #4A3A25 on light fields and in #FFFFFF on the green and brown fields; one quarter-disc number tab per reason block; a letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #A79683 used at most once per screen; section divider is one hairline rule in #4A3A25 with a short solid dash centred on it; all rendered copy carried as 「」 placeholders
